rationale: Lokesh brings deep expertise in ML engineering, data pipelines, and real-time systems that directly complements Romy's work building AI tooling and ML infrastructure at Repeat AI. With both grounded in Python and ML foundations, they can explore how practical data architecture patterns from supply chain and forecasting domains could inform the developer-friendly AI tools Repeat AI is creating.
intro_message: Lokesh kank, meet Romy Agrawal — both working on the ML/data infrastructure side of AI, and could compare notes on making these systems more accessible and practical.
